title: Quickstart: add benchmark report link with UTM params (non-intrusive)
author: Wei Chen
description:
Context: As part of the public-facing latency/$ benchmark report launch, we want the Python SDK quickstart to point interested developers to the report without making the quickstart feel like an ad or changing the primary onboarding flow.

What changed: Adds a single optional “Learn more” link to the latency/$ benchmark report in the quickstart/README content, using UTM params for attribution. The link is placed after the first successful request example (so it doesn’t block time-to-first-token) and is intentionally framed as additional reading.

UTM details (per Marketing Ops): utm_source=redwood-sdk-python&utm_medium=quickstart&utm_campaign=latency-per-dollar-benchmark

Notes: No SDK behavior changes. No new dependencies. No telemetry added.

Checklist: Docs link uses canonical URL, UTM params are consistent with other launch assets, wording stays neutral (no superiority claims), and link placement keeps the quickstart focused on getting started.

Related: PM-418 (scope/success metrics), PM-426 (launch plan/channel calendar).
commits: docs(quickstart): add optional benchmark report link after first request example
docs: standardize UTM params + keep copy neutral per claims guidelines
chore: update changelog note for docs-only tweak
illustrative_snippet:
README.md (excerpt)

After you’ve made your first request, you may also want to review our production economics benchmark report (latency/$) for model + region comparisons:
https://redwoodinference.com/benchmarks/latency-per-dollar?utm_source=redwood-sdk-python&utm_medium=quickstart&utm_campaign=latency-per-dollar-benchmark

(We keep the quickstart focused on onboarding; the report is optional context.)
conversation: Tyler Benson (review): Can you align the campaign name with the launch tracking plan? We’re using latency-per-dollar-benchmark elsewhere (with hyphens). Also please ensure the URL is the canonical landing page (not the PDF direct).
Wei Chen (author): Updated utm_campaign to latency-per-dollar-benchmark and switched to the canonical landing page URL. Left it as an optional link after the first working example.
Renee Sullivan (review): Copy looks good. Suggest changing “comparisons” to “results” to avoid implying head-to-head claims in the SDK docs. Also please keep it to one line so it doesn’t distract.
Wei Chen (author): Good call—changed “comparisons” -> “results” and tightened to a single sentence + link.
Ben Carter (review): +1. Thanks for keeping it low-key. Can we add the same link to docs/quickstart.md to keep parity with README? Not a must but preferred.
Wei Chen (author): Added to docs/quickstart.md in the same placement (post-first request).
release_notes: Docs-only: Quickstart/README now includes an optional link to the latency/$ benchmark report (with UTM params) after the first request example.
